import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 11, "text.usetex": False, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "axes.labelcolor": "#263238", "axes.edgecolor": "#657786", "xtick.color": "#657786", "ytick.color": "#657786", "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "svg.fonttype": "none", })
blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" ink = "#263238" slate = "#657786"
x = np.array([1, 2, 0, 1]) y = np.array([2, 1, 2, 0]) N = 4 if x.shape != (N,) or y.shape != (N,): raise ValueError("Both supplied signals must contain exactly N = 4 samples.") n = np.arange(N)
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.6), dpi=100) ax_input = fig.add_axes([0.075, 0.365, 0.245, 0.46]) ax_output = fig.add_axes([0.705, 0.365, 0.245, 0.46])
for ax, values, color, title in [ (ax_input, x, blue, r"Input signal $x$"), (ax_output, y, teal, r"Output signal $y = T(x)$"), ]: markers, stems, baseline = ax.stem(n, values, bottom=0) plt.setp(stems, color=color, linewidth=2.2) plt.setp( markers, marker="o", markersize=6.5, markerfacecolor=color, markeredgecolor="white", markeredgewidth=0.8, ) baseline.set_visible(False) ax.set_xlim(-0.4, 3.4) ax.set_ylim(-0.12, 2.55) ax.set_xticks(n) ax.set_yticks([0, 1, 2]) ax.spines["bottom"].set_position(("data", 0)) ax.spines["bottom"].set_linewidth(0.8) ax.spines["left"].set_linewidth(0.8) ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=10, length=3, width=0.8, pad=5) ax.set_xlabel(r"Sample index $n$", fontsize=10, labelpad=9) ax.set_ylabel("Amplitude", fontsize=10, labelpad=8) ax.set_title(title, fontsize=12, fontweight="medium", pad=12)
block = FancyBboxPatch( (0.425, 0.485), 0.17, 0.215, boxstyle="round,pad=0.006,rounding_size=0.012", transform=fig.transFigure, facecolor="#F3F7F6", edgecolor=slate, linewidth=1.1, ) fig.add_artist(block) fig.text( 0.51, 0.5925, "System\nOperator " + r"$T$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=13, linespacing=1.5, )
for start, end, color in [ ((0.335, 0.5925), (0.416, 0.5925), blue), ((0.605, 0.5925), (0.686, 0.5925), teal), ]: fig.add_artist(FancyArrowPatch( start, end, transform=fig.transFigure, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=12, linewidth=1.5, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, ))
fig.text(0.375, 0.633, r"$x$", ha="center", va="bottom", color=blue, fontsize=12) fig.text( 0.646, 0.633, r"$y=T(x)$", ha="center", va="bottom", color=teal, fontsize=10.5, ) fig.text( 0.51, 0.823, r"$N=4$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10.5, color=slate, )
fig.text( 0.51, 0.194, r"$y = T(x) = T\left([1,\,2,\,0,\,1]^{T}\right)" r" = [2,\,1,\,2,\,0]^{T}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=14, ) fig.text( 0.51, 0.086, r"$T:\ \mathbb{R}^{4}\ \rightarrow\ \mathbb{R}^{4}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12, color=slate, ) fig.text( 0.95, 0.087, "Dimensionless amplitudes", ha="right", va="center", fontsize=8, color=slate, )
